title: How long to keep receipts and tax records
label: 1-minute fix

items.t: Snap a photo the same day

items.s: Who it was with, what it was for.

cta.sub: Business Expense Tracker in our shop.

captions.instagram:
How long do you keep receipts? The IRS rules, in one list:

✔️ 3 years for most tax returns
✔️ 6 years if you left off income of more than 25% of what you reported
✔️ 7 years if you claimed a bad debt or worthless securities loss
✔️ At least 4 years for payroll (employment tax) records
✔️ Indefinitely if a return was never filed

The 1-minute habit: snap a photo the day you get it, name the file with the date, vendor and amount, and note the business reason.

Our Business Expense Tracker keeps each expense under its Schedule C category.
